title: Insiders say they have been inside non-human craft

tellings.quote: say they've gone inside these crafts.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that some insiders claim they have gone inside craft that were not made by humans. He links the claim to two men he names, Jay Stratton and Jim Lacatski, and places it in an unnamed hangar with no date given. If true, it would mean people have physically stood inside non-human vehicles.
